name: Sorceress in the Sinful Silkwood Yielding
source:
The forest near your hometown has begun to change.
When your girlfriend doesn’t return home, you decide to go looking for her.
Will you be able to find her and uncover the secrets of a forest where people suddenly start disappearing — and monster girls begin to appear?
Will you accept the help of a powerful sorceress… and will you be able to resist her temptations?
The choice is yours.
This world continues to expand and deepen.
In this story, you will encounter both familiar characters and entirely new ones.
translation:
你家乡附近的森林已经开始发生变化。
当你的女朋友没有回家时，你决定去找她。
你能找到她并揭开森林的秘密吗？那里的人们突然开始消失，怪物女孩开始出现？
你会接受强大女巫的帮助吗……你能抵制她的诱惑吗？
选择权在你。
这个世界不断扩大和深化。
在这个故事中，你会遇到熟悉的角色和全新的角色。
